description: A self-contained loopback: a tone is sent by `net_sink` (TCP client, cf32) and received by `net_source` (TCP server) on `$PORT`, then shown on a spectrum and scope.
prompt: Listen on TCP port 5600 for cf32 IQ at 250 kS/s and show me the spectrum.
needs: a sender on the port: here the same graph's `net_sink`; replace `$PORT` with a free port (e.g. 5600) and drop `tone` / `send` for an external source.
